decision.scope: Existing supported types and valid self-contained portable Personal subgraphs: literal, source-bound, input-bound and nested symbolic extents must preserve full dependency/reference meaning through save/export, typed identity remapping, import/reopen and generation.
decision.invalidBehavior: Missing dependencies, malformed or otherwise inadmissible data reject atomically with no partial resources/Graph/History; checksum alone cannot qualify usability.
decision.unchanged: No new type family, host/native capability or automatic repair of invalid input; existing owner, exact-module, portability, profile and lifetime contracts remain.
